title: Rhythm Recall · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Rhythm Recall · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner prepares a short pattern of three claps or taps. The partner performs it once; the lead repeats the same pattern. The group agrees the order and rhythm match. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Rhythm Recall, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group agrees the order and rhythm match.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group agrees the order and rhythm match.
